style: Style: vintage Saturday-morning monster cartoon still with a real horror edge, a heavy painted gouache background with deep inky blacks and one coloured light source (lantern orange or ghostly green), flat cel-painted characters with clean black outlines, anything monstrous drawn with grotesque detail and glowing eyes, high contrast, unsettling. Wide cinematic frame. No faces of the heroes shown, no text, no lettering except where stated.

pictures.wv_grinning_storm: The moor in driving rain, townsfolk running, a bonfire on a far hill and a ring of freed spirits streaming toward it
pictures.wv_grinning_storm_2: The storm clouds coiling into a grinning face with hollow eyes and lightning in its mouth
pictures.wv_effigy_revealed: A colossal wicker man standing against a huge cold moon, its shadow stretched across the moor, bonfires round its feet
pictures.wv_effigy_revealed_2: Close on the chest cage of the wicker man: a woman's small calm face behind the weave among villagers, goats, sheep and sheaves
pictures.wv_final_sacrifice: Flames climbing the wicker effigy while masked dancers caper in the firelight
pictures.wv_final_sacrifice_2: A woman's eye behind the weave and a single tear, flames rising beyond it
pictures.wv_final_sacrifice_3: The titan wicker man lurching one step forward, its eyes catching fire
pictures.wv_crooked_mans_end: The wicker man collapsing into a column of sparks over the hill
pictures.wv_crooked_mans_end_2: A shrivelled, charred, crooked specter clawing out of a heap of ash and falling still
pictures.wv_crooked_mans_end_3: Rain falling on a smoking ash heap under a hill of dying fires
pictures.wv_phillip_in_ash: A lord in a torn smouldering coat running up a dark hill in the rain
pictures.wv_phillip_in_ash_2: The same man kneeling in grey ash, lifting a blackened necklace from charred bones
